purpose: Locate the eight-start held-out root boundary below the RG ceiling 2.75 candidate.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the fine channel-saturation bridge fit.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots remain failures even when the RMS over surviving roots is small.
This replay was selected after RG ceiling 2.75 recovered roots with eight starts.
